LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiRitualPattern.shortDescOverrid: A Qixi festival celebration held beside the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_QixiRitualPattern.ritualExplanatio: The Qixi rite must be hosted by Qinghe beside the lotus pond. Ritual quality affects participants' mood; a completed rite yields a copy of "Lotus Rain Pavilion Artistry". Good outcomes may inspire handiwork or artistry.
